body.name: assignment-law-averaged information envelope
body.construction: \(\mathsf G_{\mathcal D}(v;H)=8M^2\sum_{b,i}\{u_b^2n_b^{-2}(1-p_{bi}(z_1\mid H_{bi}))/p_{bi}(z_1\mid H_{bi})+v_b^2n_b^{-2}(1-p_{bi}(z_0\mid H_{bi}))/p_{bi}(z_0\mid H_{bi})\}\), with the first summand zero off \(W\), and \(\overline{\mathsf V}_{\mathcal D,\Gamma}(v)=\sup_{Y\in\mathcal Y_{M,\Gamma}}\mathbb E_{\mathcal D,Y}[\mathsf G_{\mathcal D}(v;H)]\)
